summary: Mobile: Work Order Text Not Visible in Dark Mode on Mobile (Staging)
reported_issue: In Dark Mode on mobile, Work Order text was not properly visible — it appeared overridden by white color, causing poor contrast and making the text difficult/impossible to read.
expected_after_fix: Text should have proper contrast in Dark Mode; all Work Order text should remain clearly legible.
steps_i_followed: Logged in as admin in a mobile emulation context (390x844, isMobile+touch, iPhone UA, deviceScaleFactor 3).
Enabled Dark Mode via the app's persisted theme (localStorage 'mode' = dark), reloaded, and confirmed body class 'body--dark' with background rgb(20,24,36).
Navigated to the Work Orders section (Estimates list) and captured a screenshot; also programmatically measured text/background contrast ratios.
Attempted to open a WO detail (mobile redirected back to the list view).
actual_now: In mobile Dark Mode, Work Order text is clearly legible: WO numbers (e.g. S9-24948), customer names (Brabay Maintenance), asset/VIN values, and tab labels all render in white/light on the dark background with good contrast. Status badges ('Estimate') render in blue. No white-on-white or blended/invisible text was observed. The muted grey secondary labels ('Asset', 'Unit #') are intentional design and remain readable.
notes: Tested via Chromium mobile-viewport emulation with Dark Mode enabled (as permitted for mobile-web tickets). WO list text contrast is good; bug does not reproduce.
